proofRules.requires: Already-classified reading anchor; bounded2..12-row list, unique current-document selected peer, >=2 generic document-kind peers, and either same-topic editorial main heading or selected parent topic plus actual immediately following content section.

rankPolicy.comparator: Content evidence level precedes existing page priority, navigation priority, score and remaining deterministic keys.
rankPolicy.selection: Reserve proven level2 then level1 content before unrelated global categories. Within an equally supported relevance tier reserve category diversity before same-category additions. All content is still source-backed and bounded at6. Remaining slots use the prior task/category/fill policy.
rankPolicy.noEvidence: With no ContentEvidence, ordinary task/diversity/fill selection is unchanged. Reading source-order tie groups now retain every earlier relevance/page/navigation/score/context/purpose policy.
rankPolicy.overflow: Same original classified candidate objects; distinct destination/control deduplication; no gold-position/reverseDOM/lastlist/max6-increase shortcut.
rankPolicy.thresholdsAndActions: No classification score/threshold/category or action/href/target mutation in this helper or ranker.

safetyAndCurrentness: Reject header/footer/nav/aside/article, breadcrumbs, skip navigation, editable/custom-role/nested input regions, default/form-owned buttons and branch expanders. Only analyzer-proven safe preparation anchors may receive relevance in a form.
Document peer proof rejects explicit dangerous command metadata; new category safety still belongs to the shared classifier before contentEvidence.
All relationships rerun on every call. Identity dependencies distinguish equal-content title/list/container replacement; fingerprints omit raw queries, scripts, input values and whole region text.
Root page-session now reruns contentEvidence; focused tests directly verify equal-content heading and preparation-title replacements invalidate original candidates.
